```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
hpv_data<-read_csv("data/cm_all_ages.csv")
gt(hpv_data)
```

```{r}
NormalHPVPos<-hpv_data|>filter(Cytology=="Normal",HPV_Status=="HPV+")|>pull(N_individuals)

AbnormalHPVPos<-hpv_data|>filter(Cytology=="Abnormal",HPV_Status=="HPV+")|>pull(N_individuals)

NormalHPVNeg<-hpv_data|>filter(Cytology=="Normal",HPV_Status=="HPV-")|>pull(N_individuals)
AbnormalHPVNeg<-hpv_data|>filter(Cytology=="Abnormal",HPV_Status=="HPV-")|>pull(N_individuals)

prop_abnormal_given_hpv<-AbnormalHPVPos/(NormalHPVPos+AbnormalHPVPos)

prop_abnormal_given_no_hpv<-AbnormalHPVNeg/(NormalHPVNeg+AbnormalHPVNeg)

prop_hpv_given_abnormal<-AbnormalHPVPos/(AbnormalHPVPos+AbnormalHPVNeg)

prop_no_hpv_given_normal<-NormalHPVNeg/(NormalHPVNeg+NormalHPVPos)

print(prop_abnormal_given_hpv)

print(prop_abnormal_given_no_hpv)

print(prop_hpv_given_abnormal)

print(prop_no_hpv_given_normal)
```

```{r}
prop_hpv_given_normal <- 1 - prop_no_hpv_given_normal
```
